book.name: 2 Abhakoriinto
book.title: Enyaarubha ya kabhiri ya Pauro ku Bhakoriinto

content: Abhahokya bhe eriiragano eriihya

Mbe, muriiseega kubha turataanga kweeki okwiikoombakoomba kweemwe? Zeyi, etwe tutari kya abhaatu abhaandi bhano bhakubhareetera eziinyaarubha zyo okumumenyeekererya, kasi kusabha okurwa kweemwe eziinyaarubha zyo okumumenyeekererya kubhaatu abhaandi.
Emwe niimwe enyaarubha yeetu, yino ekaamirwe muziikoro zyeetu, na abhaatu bhoosi bharanagya okuyisoma no okuyimenyeekererya.

Mureerekya kubhweero kubha mubheeri enyaarubha yo okurwa ku Krisito, yino ekweerekya emirimo gino twaakoriri kweemwe. Enyaarubha yiyo etaakaamirwe kwo obhwiino, nawe ekaamirwe ne Ekoro wa Taatabhugya wuno ari muhoru. Kweeki etaakaamirwe kumabhaara ga kwiitare, nawe ekaamirwe muziikoro zya abhaatu.
Turagaamba gayo, kwo okubha tuno obhwiisige bhuyo ku Taatabhugya kuhitira Krisito.
Etari turiiseega kubha turanagya kukora kyokyoosi kwo obhunagya bhweetu abheene, nawe obhunagya bhweetu bhurareka ku Taatabhugya.
Ewe niwe akatuha obhunagya bhwo okubha abhahokya bhe eriiragano eriihya.
Eriiragano
riyo ritakutuukana ne emigiro gino gyakaamirwe, nawe rirarwa kwe Ekoro Muhoreeru, kwo okubha emigiro girareeta oruku, nawe Ekoro wa Taatabhugya arareeta obhuhoru.
Obhuguungo bhwe eriiragano eriihya
Emigiro gino gyakaamirwe kumagina, gino gikareeta oruku, gikaaza kwo obhuguungo bhuno bhukumesya, tee Abhiiziraeri bhakatamwa kumurora Musa
mubhusyo. Bhakatamwa kwo okubha obhuguungo bhuyo bhukamesya bhukongʼu, nawe bhukamesya kwiibhaga iguhi ego, okumara bhukazuunzazuunza.
Eraabhe obhuhokya bhwe emigiro gino gikureeta oruku gikaaza kwo obhuguungo kya bhuyo,
bhoono obhuhokya bhwe Ekoro Muhoreeru bhutakubha no obhuguungo kutuumaho?
Eraabhe emirimo gino gikukora abhaatu okutinirwa ekiina gino obhuguungo, emirimo gino gikukora abhaatu kubha bhe eheene embere wa Taatabhugya gino obhuguungo bhukuru kutuumaho!
Kweego, obhuguungo bhwe eriiragano rye ekare bhutakuriingʼaana no obhuguungo bhwe eriiragano eriihya, kwo okubha eriiragano eriihya rino obhuguungo bhukuru kukiraho.
Eraabhe kino kyaariho kwiibhaga iguhi kyaari no obhuguungo, bhoono kino kiraabheho kirakeego kino obhuguungo kukiraho.
Ambe, kwo okubha tune eriisigo riyo, turakora kwo obhukaari.
Etwe tutakukora kya Musa, wuno akiikuundikirya mubhusyo kwe ekitaambaara, okubha Abhiiziraeri bhatarora obhweero bhuno bhwaari bhukusiriikirira.

Nawe Abhiiziraeri bhateendiri kumenyeekererya. Tee bhoono hano bhakusoma Eriiragano rye Ekare, bharatamwa okumenyeekererya obhuheene, bharabha kya bhano bharibhirwe ekitaambaara kirya. Ekitaambaara kiyo kikyaari kuruusibhwaho, kiraruusibhwaho hano omuutu akumwiikirirya Krisito.
Ni heene, tee reero yino, hano bhakusoma ebhitabhu bhye emigiro gya Musa, ekitaambaara kiyo kirakuundikirya eziikoro zyaabhu, bhatamenyeekererya obhuheene.
Nawe omuutu wowoosi wuno aramukyoorera Omukuru, Omukuru aramuruusya ekitaambaara kiyo.
Bhoono, Omukuru niwe Ekoro, na hano Ekoro wo Omukuru ariho, niho obhwiiragaanzi bhuri.

Ambe, etwe twoosi bhano tutakwiikuundikirya mubhusyo ne ekitaambaara, tureerekya obhuguungo bhwo Omukuru kyeego ekirore kikweerekya epicha. Na neetwe turakyoosibhwa okurwa obhuguungo tee obhuguungo obhukuru eziisiku zyoosi. Omukuru niwe Ekoro, neewe arakora emirimo giyo, okubha tutuubhane neewe.

footnotes.text: b Eriiragano. Rora engʼana yino mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.
a Musa. Rora engʼana yino mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.
